tcp_ip_stack_guide.context: Core RFCs required for building a modern, lightweight TCP/IP stack (similar to lwIP).

architecture_layers.description: General requirements and behavioral rules for modern IP hosts.

protocols.title: Requirements for Internet Hosts - Communication Layers
protocols.notes: Acts as the definitive rulebook. Overrides older original RFCs if conflicts exist.

architecture_layers.description: Protocols for establishing physical/logical links, specifically for serial and cellular connections.

protocols.title: The Point-to-Point Protocol (PPP)
protocols.notes: The core state machine for opening and testing serial connections.

protocols.title: PPP in HDLC-like Framing
protocols.notes: Defines how to wrap IP packets in byte sequences for raw serial transmission.

protocols.title: The PPP Internet Protocol Control Protocol (IPCP)
protocols.notes: Handles IP address negotiation over a PPP serial link.

architecture_layers.description: Protocols for local network discovery, routing, and basic diagnostics.

protocols.title: An Ethernet Address Resolution Protocol
protocols.notes: Translates IPv4 addresses to hardware MAC addresses.

protocols.title: Internet Protocol
protocols.notes: Core routing, header parsing, and checksum verification.

protocols.title: Internet Control Message Protocol
protocols.notes: Required for basic diagnostic responses like Echo Request/Reply (ping).

architecture_layers.description: Protocols handling end-to-end data movement and port multiplexing.

protocols.title: User Datagram Protocol
protocols.notes: Lightweight, connectionless transport. Adds ports to IP routing.

protocols.title: Transmission Control Protocol
protocols.notes: The modern, consolidated TCP specification (obsoletes RFC 793). Contains the core state machine, windowing, and congestion control.

architecture_layers.description: Protocols for behaving as a dynamic citizen on a network.

protocols.title: Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol
protocols.notes: Required for dynamic IP allocation on Ethernet/Wi-Fi networks.

protocols.title: Domain Names - Implementation and Specification
protocols.notes: Requires at least a 'Stub Resolver' implementation to convert URLs to IPs via UDP.

architecture_layers.description: The modern IP stack, replacing ARP with NDP and integrating ICMP deeply.

protocols.title: Internet Protocol, Version 6 (IPv6) Specification
protocols.notes: The core IPv6 specification, obsoleting RFC 2460.

protocols.title: Internet Control Message Protocol (ICMPv6) for IPv6
Neighbor Discovery for IP version 6 (IPv6)
protocols.notes: Replaces ARP. Handles router and neighbor discovery.

protocols.title: IPv6 Stateless Address Autoconfiguration
protocols.notes: Allows devices to self-assign IPv6 addresses without a DHCP server.
